  "markdown": "[Skip to main content](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes.html#main-content)

These are user contributed clothes for MakeHuman. Note that they are not created, nor endorsed, by the MakeHuman crew. You use them at your own risk. If you wish more information on clothes (including on how to create them), take a look in the [wiki](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/wiki) (particularly the FAQ on [how to install clothes](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/wiki/FAQ:I_downloaded_third_part_clothes._How_do_I_install_them%3F)). New users may be interested in the [MakeClothes tutorial by VscorpianC](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eskfzfU4NsI).

In order to comment contributions or upload new items you need to be logged in. You can [log in](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/user/) using your forum username and password. If you do not have a forum account, go [here](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/forum) and click "register".

If you rather browse by thumbnail, there is also a [thumbnail gallery](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothesgallery.html).

Click [here](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/add/clothes) if you want to upload new clothes.

If an asset is broken or if you want to nominate an asset for "community favorite", you can use the [tag request system](http://www.makehumancommunity.org/tagrequests.html) to request that a moderator tag the item.

If you plan to download many clothes, it's probably more convenient to do so via the "community assets" plugin found in the [community-plugins repository](https://github.com/makehumancommunity/community-plugins). By using this, you can download assets from within MakeHuman instead of doing so manually.
